QuestInfo.0: The #b#p2140000##k of the #b#m270000000##k knows who has the most Charm in all of Maple World. Talk to #p2140000#.

#p2140000# tells you that the most beautiful being is the Goddess of Time, but with your Charm, you should be able to get a blessing from the Goddess with the right offering.

0.0: We are not accepting common worshipers. Be on your way... Oh, you have a question for the Goddess? I can tell you myself, who the most beautiful being in Maple World is...the Goddess of Time herself, of course.
0.1: She who commands time possess eternal beautiful. No human can compare. You may be beautiful by human standards, but the Goddess is on a different level. However, maybe the Goddess will show you grace and bestow upon you that which you lack.

yes.0: Offer a sacrifice to the Goddess, and she will bestow upon you her blessing. #bFight the 3 strongest beings in this temple and bring me the items they drop#k.

no.0: Uninterested? Of course. Humans lose interest in eternal things so easily...

1.0: Yes, these will do. Give them to me. I will offer them to the Goddess on your behalf.

yes.0: A title has been bestowed upon you by the Goddess.

item.0: You appear with no offerings? You must #bfight the 3 strongest beings in this temple and bring the items they drops#k.
